body: Audit B-51 (proven on an emulator, offline, 6 Nov 2026): after an album or playlist has played to its end the player waits paused on the last song, and the Play button of that page (detail_screens.dart:111-112) only toggles play/pause, so it replays the last song alone and then stops; it should start the list from the first song. Small fix plus a playback test. See docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-51 and docs/evidence/README.md#d01. Also recorded there: the Download and offline path passed on the emulator (download in under 8 s, offline library, offline playback, queue advance).
